headline: There is little dead code: about 2,700 lines of 772,000 (0.35%), thin over some 400 files and dropped by the build, and none of it is a feature waiting for opening: it is code with no caller. The one run-time price is the 19,614-line schema that every cold start evaluates for a query builder nobody calls (150 to 190 ms and about 18 MB, measured here): three lines to change, the same fix as DS-1 and DP-1. The planner's own check added one cost the report missed: a unit test replays all 789 archived migrations on every run (6.2 s and about 630 MB, measured). The plan is a guard first (the review's scan as an exact-list ratchet, about 9 s a run), then deletion in tiers: 721 lines nothing uses, about 230 in three dead files, and about 1,700 that only a test keeps alive.

findings.title: Every cold start evaluates the 19,614-line schema that no query reads
findings.saving: 150 to 190 ms and about 18 MB per cold start (measured here; estimate for Vercel); about 0.8 MB off each of 6 server chunks

findings.title: Nothing counts unused code, so it grows unseen
findings.saving: Keeps about 2,700 dead lines from growing back (about 57 a day at the measured rate); costs about 9 s in the unit-test run

findings.title: 331 exports are used by nothing at all, and some say they are in use
Three files only tests reach, and a rule that still describes one of them
findings.saving: About 230 lines (measured), and a rule that names the editor the product really uses

findings.title: About 330 exports in production files are kept alive only by a test
findings.saving: About 1,700 source lines and 1,000 to 2,000 test lines (estimate); not additive with DD-7

findings.title: English words kept twice: old constants beside the catalogues, held equal by tests
findings.saving: Up to about 500 lines and 30 to 40 assertions; part of DD-2's and DD-3's totals, not on top

findings.title: Three Work actions have no screen: a logged time entry's hours cannot be corrected
findings.saving: About 130 lines removed, or one finished feature (edit a time entry) and about 80 lines removed

findings.title: The invoice-PDF job has a route and a retry button, but nothing ever calls it
findings.saving: A retry sentence that is true and no cold Chromium on a first download; or about 60 lines and one deployed function removed

findings.title: One unit test replays all 789 archived migrations on every run
findings.saving: About 6 s and about 630 MB of peak memory per unit-test run (measured here), and 98 test lines

findings.title: Tests that quote or replay migrations no database will run again
findings.saving: About 320 test lines and a 40-line helper (measured), one PGlite build a run, two guards re-pointed at live migrations

findings.title: Small things kept from before: old redirects, a twin switch, a second scheduler, an old schema
findings.saving: About 100 source and 150 test lines, 8 redirect patterns, one trigger branch; daily run and 34 tables are counted in CR-12 and DS-14

findings.title: Upgraders for three old page shapes: almost free to run, still fed by today's code, and pinned by a rule and a spec
findings.saving: About 240 lines and part of seven test files (estimate); no run-time saving

findings.title: Live drills can only be asked for by hand-written SQL, and their job polls every five minutes
findings.saving: A usable door for the platform team, or a true description; the two idle queries a pass are counted in CR-2
